bagPolicy.summary: Bags cannot be larger than 14 × 14 inches; the FAQ lists backpacks, luggage and large bags under that limit.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.summary: The theatre lists street parking on Wilshire Boulevard and directs visitors to its Getting Here page for other options.
parking.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

rideshare.summary: Rideshare such as Lyft or Uber is strongly recommended because the theatre is in a residential area.

concessions.summary: Venue concessions are cashless. Alcohol is available to guests at least 21 with a current government photo ID.
concessions.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

accessibility.summary: All entrances are accessible. ADA viewing is on the right side when facing the stage; ask a venue representative for assistance.
accessibility.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

reEntry.summary: The theatre does not permit re-entry after a ticket has been scanned.
reEntry.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

ticketPickup.summary: The El Rey box office opens at doors on the night of each show. If the show isn't sold out in advance, you can buy tickets there with cash or credit card.

gates.summary: Doors typically open one hour before showtime; confirm the exact opening on the event calendar.
gates.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.
